artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a watermark/logo text 'JEWELRYTOGO.COM'. While legible, AI-generated text often has slight kerning or edge softness issues. Here it looks relatively clean but warrants verification as an artifact of generation vs real photography overlay.

artifact_observations.location: Chain links near the pendant connection
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/blurring in the smallest links connecting the pendant to the main chain, potentially indicating minor generative smoothing or depth-of-field simulation errors.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of jewelry and distinguish it from other accessories like bracelets or anklets.
To verify that the interlocking links are topologically correct (closed loops) and not fused or broken, which is a common AI failure mode in complex chains.
To analyze the legibility and structural integrity of the 'JEWELRYTOGO.COM' text to rule out AI text artifacts.
To assess the realism of reflections on the metal and stones, ensuring they match the lighting environment.

focus_areas: Integrity of interlocking chain links (no fusion/breaks)
Realism of specular highlights on metal and gemstones
Legibility and structure of the watermark text
Connection point between pendant and chain
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the topology of the chain links. AI often struggles with maintaining consistent closed loops in long chains. Check if the links merge into each other or break unexpectedly. Also, verify if the reflections on the gems are physically consistent with a single light source.
